⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Number of PCM samples at the beginning of a stream to discard (encoder pre-roll).

For Opus this is the pre-skip reported in the Ogg-Opus header (typically
312 samples at 48 kHz). When logging raw packets without a container,
record the value here so the decoder can trim output at stream start.
